label: Premature adult death
unit: probability of dying between 15 and 60, per 1,000 (WHO)

label: Share of life lived in ill health
Alcohol and drug deaths
unit: deaths from alcohol and drug use disorders per 100k (WHO GHE)

label: Anti-LGBTI laws
unit: LGBTI Composite Policy Index, sign reversed (Velasco, via OWID)

label: Violent deaths
unit: homicide (UNODC, WHO fallback) + conflict deaths (UCDP) + suicide (WHO) per 100k

label: People held captive
unit: prisoners + people in modern slavery per 100k

label: Overwork
unit: % of employed working 49+ hours a week (ILO)

label: Forcibly displaced people
unit: refugees, asylum seekers and IDPs by origin per 100k (UNHCR)

label: Farm-animal mistreatment
unit: Animal Protection Index 2020 farm-animal grade, A = 0 to G = 100
